selectionBasis: Initial conditions and operator-event input completeness in NUREG/IA-0231 Tables 1 and 2, before extracting or evaluating the ATWS-11 measured pressure response.
windowReason: The published outsurge mass flow is not tabulated for ATWS-11. Stop two seconds before the Table 2 draining event at 297 s; do not infer outflow from pressure or extend the comparison through an unidentified boundary.

forcing.interpolation: Piecewise linear between knots; hold the terminal value only within the declared simulation window.

inputQualifications: 5.9 MPa, 3.5 m and 0.217 kg/s are the rounded measured initial/input values in Table 1.
Heater shutdown at 100 s and insurge initiation at 119 s are Table 2 operator events.
The one-second boundary ramps are a declared approximation following the ATWS-10 appendix input convention. ATWS-11's actual high-frequency flow ramp is unavailable.

The ATWS-10 appendix supplies 547 K inlet/wall and 547.64 K fluid temperatures. ATWS-11 has the same initial pressure; reusing these thermal initial/boundary assumptions is explicit, not an additional measured ATWS-11 temperature record.
The vessel geometry, material and exterior-loss assumptions are shared unchanged with the fixed candidate model. No held-out pressure point may set them.
The facility's 245 kW core power maintains external loop conditions and is not deposited directly into the pressurizer.

numericalProtocol.spatialConvergence: Use the model configuration frozen before unblinding. Do not select a mesh by held-out response error.

scoring.graphicalAllowance: Two pixels in each axis, determined from reviewed Figure 6 axis calibration independently of model results.
scoring.timeAlignment: None; retain printed times and operator events.
scoring.offsetCorrection: None; retain any mismatch between Table 1 initialization and Figure 6 pressure.
scoring.acceptance: No blanket physical-validation pass. Report conditional envelope coverage descriptively and separately from numerical acceptance.

developmentSeparation.rule: Record candidate model, wrapper, runner and comparator hashes before computing held-out errors. A later model change invalidates the original holdout claim; retain prior results and label subsequent evaluations as post-unblinding.
developmentSeparation.qualification: Same-facility independent experiment with response withheld from this development cycle. The source report's general discussion was already available; this is not a historically blind external certification study.
